samples.question: A set of thin dark rods is drawn on a white canvas. Imagine extending each rod's long axis as a straight line. In one arrangement every extended line passes through a single shared center point, so the rods radiate outward like the spokes of one hidden wheel; in the other arrangement the rods point in unrelated directions and their extended lines share no common point. Do all the rods converge toward one shared center? Choose: yes, no.
